name: PPAP Automotive Ltd
title: PPAP Automotive Ltd - 532934 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue INR175.5 cr (+18.6% YoY) with utilisation ~78%, but FY27 guidance withheld, FY26 guidance missed, and battery still loss-making; supply discipline is not evidenced.

utilisation.quote: Capacity utilization levels also improved meaningfully to approximately 78%, reflecting stronger throughput across facilities

triggers.label: Utilisation ~78% in Q4
triggers.quote: Capacity utilization levels also improved meaningfully to approximately 78%

triggers.label: FY27 guidance deferred to Q1
triggers.quote: the company has decided that it will provide its financial year '27 guidance during the quarter 1 financial year '27 earnings announcement

triggers.label: Raw material cost pass-through ~50% covered
triggers.quote: out of that, almost 50% is already covered with the customer. We have the pass -on policy with the customer.

triggers.label: Battery loss cut 60-70%, PBT profit targeted
triggers.quote: this battery segment should be profitable at the PBT level

guidance.value: to be given in Q1 FY27 results
guidance.quote: the company has decided that it will provide its financial year '27 guidance during the quarter 1 financial year '27 earnings announcement
we expect that the whole plant and machinery will be 100% utilized in this year, financial year '27
over a period of time in next year, I think utilization will improve to 80%, 82%
this year, on a stand -alone basis, this battery segment should be profitable at the PBT level

prior_guidance_check.quote: resulting in a variance even against the revised guidance

red_flags.quote: the company has decided that it will provide its financial year '27 guidance during the quarter 1 financial year '27 earnings announcement

red_flags.label: One-time wage code charge INR3.6 cr
red_flags.quote: an additional one -time employee benefit obligation of approximately INR3.6 crores arising from the Labor Code implementation challenges

red_flags.label: Gross debt INR195 cr vs net INR103 cr
red_flags.quote: On the net level, our debt is reduced to INR103 crores. For the gross level, it is around INR195 crores

evasions.quote: So this year, based on what orders we executed in quarter 4, in financial year '27, we expect a full recovery of this business.
